systems.owner: Direction générale des impôts, finance ministry (circular 065 of 2026-09-10)
systems.tiers: suppliers of the Commune of N'Djamena open accounts and issue invoices on it; the commune may refuse non-compliant invoices at liquidation and payment

note: The N'Djamena commune's notice of 2026-09-29 requires suppliers to invoice through the national e-invoice platform; it states nothing about the commune office's own connection.
